title: CurseCore Field: Progression
summary: Move from live minor curses into deeper consequence systems only after cleansing is dependable.

blocks.title: Minor Curses
blocks.body: Start with Echo Rot and Glass Veins so players learn readable symptoms and low-risk cleansing.

blocks.title: Cleansing Route
blocks.body: Use RitualCore Curse Cleansing I as the middle safety layer. It should fail clearly when no active curse exists.

blocks.title: Future Depth
blocks.body: Rift Hunger, Soul Static, Phantom Burn, Blood Debt, Void Mark, contracts, and curse HUD polish belong after the first loop is stable.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
